jobs.title: Assistant Planner/Project & Operations Support
jobs.description:
**Project Planning \& Operational Support Coordinator**

**Location:** Leeds (Hybrid – typically 2–3 days per month in the office)  
**Salary:** Competitive, depending on experience  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly organised and commercially aware Project Planning \& Operational Support Coordinator to join our growing team in Leeds.

This is a varied role that sits across project planning, project support and business operations. We are looking for someone who understands how construction projects are planned and programmed, but who isn't necessarily a traditional, full\-time construction Planner.

You will need to be comfortable reading and understanding construction programmes, recognising key activities, dependencies, milestones and potential delays, and helping project teams keep things moving. At the same time, you'll play a broader role in supporting the day\-to\-day running of projects and the wider business.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone with experience in a construction environment who enjoys variety, problem\-solving and working across different areas of a business, rather than wanting a role focused solely on producing programmes.

**What You'll Be Doing**

Your responsibilities will be varied and will include:

* Supporting the development, review and maintenance of construction programmes.
* Understanding project timelines, key milestones, dependencies and critical activities.
* Working with project teams to monitor progress against programme and identify potential issues.
* Helping to coordinate project actions, deliverables and deadlines.
* Producing project updates, trackers, reports and management information.
* Supporting project managers with planning, coordination and general project administration.
* Assisting with project mobilisation and ensuring key information and actions are in place.
* Providing operational support across different areas of the business as required.
* Helping to improve internal processes, systems and ways of working.
* Coordinating information between project teams, management and other stakeholders.
* Identifying potential problems and helping the team find practical solutions.
* Taking ownership of tasks and seeing them through to completion.
* Supporting ad\-hoc business and operational projects.

The role will evolve as the business grows, so there will be plenty of opportunity for someone who is proactive and wants to take responsibility rather than simply work from a fixed job description.

**About You**

We are looking for someone who has a good understanding of construction projects and programming, combined with strong organisational and communication skills.

You might currently be working as a:

* Assistant Planner or Junior Planner
* Project Coordinator
* Project Administrator
* Assistant Project Manager
* Construction Coordinator
* Site/Project Support professional
* Commercial or operational support professional within construction

You don't need to be an expert Planner. We are more interested in your understanding of how construction projects work, your ability to interpret and work with programmes, and your willingness to get involved across the wider business.

You'll ideally have:

* Experience working within the construction or built environment sector.
* A good understanding of construction project planning and programming.
* The ability to read, understand and discuss construction programmes.
* Strong organisational and time\-management skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.
* A proactive, practical and solutions\-focused approach.
* The ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with project teams.
* The confidence to communicate with people at different levels of the business.

Experience with Primavera P6, Microsoft Project or similar programming software would be useful, but extensive programming experience is not essential.

**The Person**

We're looking for someone who is organised without being overly rigid, analytical without being purely desk\-based, and comfortable getting stuck into whatever needs doing.

You should enjoy having a varied workload and be someone who naturally spots things that need attention rather than waiting to be told.

You don't have to know everything. What matters is that you understand the construction environment, can get to grips with project information quickly, and have the initiative to find answers and make things happen.

**Why Join Us?**

This is a genuinely hybrid role, with an expectation of being in our Leeds office approximately 2–3 days per month, with the remainder of your time working remotely.

You'll have the opportunity to work across a variety of projects and business functions, giving you exposure well beyond a traditional planning position.

For the right person, this role could develop into a broader project management, planning or operational management position as the business continues to grow.

Pay: £30,000\.00\-£50,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Leeds (West Yorkshire, Yorkshire and Humber Region)

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**POSITION OVERVIEW**  

FRONTSTEPS is the software HOA and community management companies run their businesses on. When you are the operating system for someone’s entire business, the relationship matters as much as the product. That is where you come in.  

**The role:** Own a book of 25 to 35 strategic accounts and be the person our customers trust most. Show them features they did not know they had. Connect them to the right expert. Keep them ahead of our roadmap. Make them feel genuinely supported by software they rely on every day. Support keeps our customers running. You make them thrive.  

**Why you’ll love it here:** We are AI\-forward for real. We build internal AI tools for our own teams, and if it can be automated, we have automated it, so your time goes to customers, not busywork. We work in person at our Denver HQ, where solving a problem means walking across the hall to Product or Sales, not filing a ticket and waiting.  

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS (What You’ll Actually Do)*** Own a book of 25 to 35 mid\-market and enterprise partners and build deep, high\-touch relationships.
* Run monthly strategic meetings and that show real ROI, on\-site where feasible.
* Monitor usage data and health scores to drive adoption and catch churn risk.
* Teach customers the features they are missing, or connect them with the expert who can.
* Keep customers excited about what is coming on our roadmap.
* Own escalations end to end: when a support case stalls past 24 hours, you drive it and own the communication.
* Spot expansion opportunities and hand them off to Sales.
* Guide new customers from sales handoff through Go\-Live, then become their primary point of contact.
* Work AI\-first with our internal tools. AI adoption is an evaluation criterion here, not a nice\-to\-have.
* Keep Salesforce flawless. It is our single source of truth.
* Performs other job duties as requested by management.

  

**SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS**  

**What You Bring to the Table (Required):*** **1 to 3 years of Customer Success experience** with a track record of hitting retention goals.
* **A hunter mindset for solutions:** resilient, high EQ, runs toward complex challenges with urgency.
* **A listener who solves:** you uncover pain points, get customers to the right solution, and know when to flag a need to Sales.
* **AI fluency:** you already use AI daily and want to push what it can do.
* **Exceptional communication:** you build trust with front\-line admins and executive sponsors alike.
* **Hyper\-local to Denver:** full\-time onsite at our Denver HQ.

  

**What You Bring to the Table (Bonus Points):*** Experience with HOA accounting, HOA software, PropTech, or accounting software.
* Coming from the field? Community managers, HOA accountants, and management company operators looking to cross over into tech are strongly encouraged to apply. You already speak our customers’ language.
* Mastery of Salesforce and modern CS data frameworks.

**SUCCESS METRICS (How We Measure Impact)*** **Retention:** GRR, churn, and risk caught 90 days before renewal.
* **Adoption:** product usage and feature adoption across your book.
* **Engagement:** monthly meeting coverage and QBR completion and quality.
* **Customer Satisfaction:** CSAT and NPS.
* **Revenue Contribution:** quality expansion opportunities handed to Sales.
* **Operational Excellence:** Salesforce hygiene, process adherence, and AI adoption.

**BENEFITS \& PERKS*** Covered monthly parking onsite, paid by FRONTSTEPS.
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage.
* 401(k) retirement plan.
* Unlimited PTO and 10 paid company holidays.
* Variable performance comp tied to retention results.
* Internal AI tools and leading AI platforms so your time goes to customers, not busywork.
* Downtown Denver HQ with direct access to Product, Sales, and executive leadership.

**Supervisory Responsibility**  

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.  

**Work Environment**  

This job operates in an in\-office setting and routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, copiers, and scanners.  

**Physical Demands**  

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to sit; stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; and reach with arms and hands.
*Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.*  

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*  

FRONTSTEPS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.  



**Benefits for Full Time roles include the following:**


* 100% company paid onsite employee parking


* Medical, Dental, and Vision


* Company\-sponsored Life Insurance


* Voluntary Short\-Term Disability, Long\-Term Disability, and Life Insurance


* FSA/HSA


* Paid Time Off


* Sick Time


* 401k match


FRONTSTEPS is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Assistant Planner
jobs.description:
**THE POSITION**
----------------


**With supervisor approval, incumbents may be eligible for intermittent remote work;** **however, they must physically** **reside** **within the Sacramento region or** **have the ability to** **regularly report to a City of Sacramento physical worksite with little notice.**  

  

The Planning Division of the Community Development Department is seeking an Assistant Planner to join the Current Planning Section. This position is part of a team focused on the Central Area; a region that includes the River District, the Railyards, Downtown, Midtown, East Sacramento, and Campus Commons. This position primarily manages the review of development applications that require a public hearing. Secondary functions include assisting with general inquiries received from the public and facilitating pre\-application discussions with developers. This recruitment is being conducted to fill one vacancy.  

  

**IDEAL CANDIDATE STATEMENT**  

  

The ideal candidate will exhibit success with the following:

* Technical Skill: Demonstrates knowledge of principles and practices of planning within an urban setting, including architectural and site design review, historic preservation, the California Environmental Quality Act, and/or the Subdivision Map Act.
* Collaboration \& Conflict Resolution: Establishes rapport and maintains mutually productive relationships with internal and external customers, and pursues solutions centered on shared goals.
* Professionalism \& Adaptability: Demonstrates ability to create an action plan using available information and resources, manage multiple tasks based on established priorities, and maintain effectiveness when experiencing changes in processes and regulations.

  

**ASSISTANT PLANNER / ASSOCIATE PLANNER**  

  

To perform professional, technical, statistical and analytical duties involving land use or other planning studies for a variety of public or private development projects. The scope of assignments includes project management work, land use studies, policy development recommendation, revision or implementation, and preparation of a variety of documents for compliance with state or federal environmental laws.  

  

**DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS**  

  

**Assistant Planner**  

  

**The class of Assistant Planner is distinguished from Associate Planner by performing less complex to moderately difficult project management work. Incumbents in this class may work independently on assignments but generally do not have the responsibility for team leadership. Positions are flexibly staffed and are normally filled by advancement from the Junior Planner class.**  

  

**Associate Planner**  

  

**The class of Associate Planner is distinguished from that of Assistant Planner by the greater complexity of assignments received, and the advanced planning project management work. Associate Planners manage projects with greater independence and limited supervision and lead project teams made up of individuals from various technical disciplines. Positions are flexibly staffed and are normally filled from the Assistant Planner class**  

  

**SUPERVISION RECEIVED AND EXERCISED**  

  

**General direction is provided by a manager who is usually a Senior Planner. Associate Planners may provide direct or indirect supervision and training of other subordinate technicians, planners, or interns. The Assistant Planner usually does not perform direct or indirect supervision of staff.**
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------------------


Depending upon assignment, duties performed by the Assistant Planner may include, but are not limited to the following:  

  

  



* Review and analyze proposed minor development projects for conformance with adopted City plans, design/architectural guidelines and standards, applicable codes and ordinances and other regulations, and prepares recommendations on approval of such projects.
* Review proposed tentative subdivision and parcels maps, and recommend necessary revisions to meet City requirements.
* Evaluate the environmental effects of proposed projects and prepare, or supervise the preparation of environmental documents.
* Conduct onsite investigations of proposed development projects or community areas.
* Provide information to the public on City of Sacramento requirements related to City planning, policies, and procedures.
* Prepare and present data in the form of written, graphic, or oral reports for use by elected and appointed officials, special committees, or community organizations involved in planning matters.
* Assist in the coordination of departmental activities with other City departments and divisions, and with outside agencies.
* Participate in special projects and perform related duties as assigned.
* Negotiate, prepare and manage consultant contracts.
* Facilitate discussion groups to aid in building consensus, and resolve conflicts on projects and policy matters, under supervision of a Planning Manager.
* Other related duties may also be performed; not all duties listed may necessarily be performed by each individual holding this classification.

  

Depending upon assignment, additional duties performed by the Associate Planner may include, but are not limited to the following:  

  

  

* Compile and analyze data and make recommendations on complex planning matters, involving issues related to land use, traffic, parking, aesthetics, environment, landscaping, energy and preservation.
* Review and analyze proposed major development projects for conformance with adopted City plans, City design/architectural guidelines and standards, applicable codes and ordinances and other regulations; prepare recommendations on approval of such projects.
* Review criteria for various Federal and State grants and prepare necessary reports.
* Develop work programs, budgets, scope of work, and time estimates.
* Program, coordinate, and oversee the work of other pl

new_jobs.description:
**THE POSITION**
----------------


**With supervisor approval, incumbents may be eligible for intermittent remote work;** **however, they must physically** **reside** **within the Sacramento region or** **have the ability to** **regularly report to a City of Sacramento physical worksite with little notice.**  

  

The Planning Division of the Community Development Department is seeking an Assistant Planner to join the Current Planning Section. This position is part of a team focused on the Central Area; a region that includes the River District, the Railyards, Downtown, Midtown, East Sacramento, and Campus Commons. This position primarily manages the review of development applications that require a public hearing. Secondary functions include assisting with general inquiries received from the public and facilitating pre\-application discussions with developers. This recruitment is being conducted to fill one vacancy.  

  

**IDEAL CANDIDATE STATEMENT**  

  

The ideal candidate will exhibit success with the following:

* Technical Skill: Demonstrates knowledge of principles and practices of planning within an urban setting, including architectural and site design review, historic preservation, the California Environmental Quality Act, and/or the Subdivision Map Act.
* Collaboration \& Conflict Resolution: Establishes rapport and maintains mutually productive relationships with internal and external customers, and pursues solutions centered on shared goals.
* Professionalism \& Adaptability: Demonstrates ability to create an action plan using available information and resources, manage multiple tasks based on established priorities, and maintain effectiveness when experiencing changes in processes and regulations.

  

**ASSISTANT PLANNER / ASSOCIATE PLANNER**  

  

To perform professional, technical, statistical and analytical duties involving land use or other planning studies for a variety of public or private development projects. The scope of assignments includes project management work, land use studies, policy development recommendation, revision or implementation, and preparation of a variety of documents for compliance with state or federal environmental laws.  

  

**DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS**  

  

**Assistant Planner**  

  

**The class of Assistant Planner is distinguished from Associate Planner by performing less complex to moderately difficult project management work. Incumbents in this class may work independently on assignments but generally do not have the responsibility for team leadership. Positions are flexibly staffed and are normally filled by advancement from the Junior Planner class.**  

  

**Associate Planner**  

  

**The class of Associate Planner is distinguished from that of Assistant Planner by the greater complexity of assignments received, and the advanced planning project management work. Associate Planners manage projects with greater independence and limited supervision and lead project teams made up of individuals from various technical disciplines. Positions are flexibly staffed and are normally filled from the Assistant Planner class**  

  

**SUPERVISION RECEIVED AND EXERCISED**  

  

**General direction is provided by a manager who is usually a Senior Planner. Associate Planners may provide direct or indirect supervision and training of other subordinate technicians, planners, or interns. The Assistant Planner usually does not perform direct or indirect supervision of staff.**
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------------------


Depending upon assignment, duties performed by the Assistant Planner may include, but are not limited to the following:  

  

  



* Review and analyze proposed minor development projects for conformance with adopted City plans, design/architectural guidelines and standards, applicable codes and ordinances and other regulations, and prepares recommendations on approval of such projects.
* Review proposed tentative subdivision and parcels maps, and recommend necessary revisions to meet City requirements.
* Evaluate the environmental effects of proposed projects and prepare, or supervise the preparation of environmental documents.
* Conduct onsite investigations of proposed development projects or community areas.
* Provide information to the public on City of Sacramento requirements related to City planning, policies, and procedures.
* Prepare and present data in the form of written, graphic, or oral reports for use by elected and appointed officials, special committees, or community organizations involved in planning matters.
* Assist in the coordination of departmental activities with other City departments and divisions, and with outside agencies.
* Participate in special projects and perform related duties as assigned.
* Negotiate, prepare and manage consultant contracts.
* Facilitate discussion groups to aid in building consensus, and resolve conflicts on projects and policy matters, under supervision of a Planning Manager.
* Other related duties may also be performed; not all duties listed may necessarily be performed by each individual holding this classification.

  

Depending upon assignment, additional duties performed by the Associate Planner may include, but are not limited to the following:  

  

  

* Compile and analyze data and make recommendations on complex planning matters, involving issues related to land use, traffic, parking, aesthetics, environment, landscaping, energy and preservation.
* Review and analyze proposed major development projects for conformance with adopted City plans, City design/architectural guidelines and standards, applicable codes and ordinances and other regulations; prepare recommendations on approval of such projects.
* Review criteria for various Federal and State grants and prepare necessary reports.
* Develop work programs, budgets, scope of work, and time estimates.
